title: Physical editor paths · candidate qualification
target: Instrumented isolated desktop with native macOS input

cases.title: Physical bin-to-timeline drop
cases.expected: Dragging the observed media row onto V1 creates the correct source clip with its full duration; one Undo restores the empty timeline.

evidence.caption: Application readback and native input receipts.
The owned app or displayed preview at the observed result.

steps.title: Create and open a disposable timeline
Drag the observed media row onto V1
Check the source, position and duration
Capture the result and restore with Undo

cases.title: Physical bin drop overwrites existing material
cases.expected: Dropping at the start replaces covered material with the requested source, preserves a later clip and restores the baseline with one Undo.

evidence.caption: Application readback and native input receipts.
The owned app or displayed preview at the observed result.

cases.title: Render Graph native node move and pan
cases.expected: A header drag changes one node's scene position; middle-button panning changes its screen position while preserving graph contents and scene positions.

evidence.caption: Application readback and native input receipts.
The owned app or displayed preview at the observed result.
Before and after graph state used to check the node or connection.

steps.title: Prepare a blur graph and capture its starting layout
Drag the blur node by its header
Check that scene position changed and graph contents stayed intact
Pan the canvas with the middle mouse button
Check that only the view moved and capture the result

cases.title: Render Graph physical port connection
cases.expected: A physical output-to-input drag restores a deliberately disconnected source/effect edge; Undo removes it and Redo restores it.

evidence.caption: Application readback and native input receipts.
The owned app or displayed preview at the observed result.
Before and after graph state used to check the node or connection.

steps.title: Prepare a disconnected blur input and observe its visible ports
Drag the source output onto the blur input
Read the exact connection and capture the connected graph
Check that Undo removes the edge and Redo restores it

cases.title: Render Graph native copy, paste and delete
cases.expected: Copy/paste mints an independent effect node with matching parameters; Delete removes the copy; Undo restores it and then restores the original graph.

evidence.caption: Application readback and native input receipts.
The owned app or displayed preview at the observed result.
Before and after graph state used to check the node or connection.

steps.title: Prepare and select a blur node; preserve the system clipboard
Copy the node and paste it through native shortcuts
Check the new identity, matching parameters and unchanged original
Select and delete the pasted node; check that it is gone
Undo Delete and Paste to recover the original graph
Restore the system clipboard

cases.title: Primary wheel drag with live preview sampling
cases.expected: On a fresh clip with an existing primary grade and warmed displayed frame, a ten-second native wheel drag changes grade parameters and displayed pixels during the held gesture; one Undo restores the preceding state. Samples and response timings are retained.

evidence.caption: Application readback and native input receipts.
The owned app or displayed preview at the observed result.
Preview samples played at their recorded spacing during the held gesture.

steps.title: Prepare a clip, open the control and capture the baseline
Hold a ten-second native drag and sample the preview
Check changed parameters and evolving frames during the drag
Undo and check that the graph and displayed frame are restored
